Luke, saw Contruent raise late last year and push the capital-project platform into new verticals like mining lifecycle cost management.

Most RevOps teams in that spot have more in-market accounts than the team can act on, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a signal play for Contruent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Luke, quick follow-up for Contruent.

The gap most RevOps leaders fight is speed: a signal fires, but a rep doesn't touch the account for days, so it cools. Tightening that loop with our best practices typically lifts response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change to cut that latency for Contruent.

Luke, last bit of proof for Contruent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Contruent's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
